Postplacental insertion of GyneFix postpartum intrauterine device (PPIUD)
cohort: 470 women who underwent C-section and consented to postplacental insertion of GyneFix PPIUD
finding: Postplacental insertion of GyneFix PPIUD in women undergoing C-section was found to be effective, safe, and acceptable, with a 1-year continuation rate of 86.6%.
mod_finding: The study focuses on postplacental insertion of IUD, which is inherently related to mode of delivery (cesarean section).
